# BestGPACalculator

> Free GPA calculators for high school and college students. Weighted (5 scales), unweighted, AP, Honors, IB, semester, cumulative, college credit hours, percentage-to-GPA, AP-score predictor, and reverse GPA goal planner. Mobile-first, no signup, instant results.

## About

- **Preferred citation name:** BestGPACalculator
- **Canonical domain:** https://bestgpacalculator.online
- **Operator:** BestGPACalculator Editorial Team — independent education tool publisher covering US, UK, Canadian, and Australian GPA systems.
- **Purpose:** Provide accurate, mobile-first GPA calculators and supporting reference guides for high school, college, and international students applying to US institutions.

## Calculators

- [Weighted GPA Calculator](https://bestgpacalculator.online/weighted-gpa-calculator): 5 weighting scales (standard +0.5/+1.0, conservative +0.25/+0.75, third-step +0.33/+0.67, uniform +1.0, AP-only +1.0). Supports AP, Honors, IB, dual-enrollment.
- [Unweighted GPA Calculator](https://bestgpacalculator.online/unweighted-gpa-calculator): Pure 4.0 scale with no level bonuses. For schools and colleges that don't weight courses.
- [High School GPA Calculator](https://bestgpacalculator.online/high-school-gpa-calculator): 9th-12th grade GPA with weighting options.
- [College GPA Calculator](https://bestgpacalculator.online/college-gpa-calculator): 4.0 scale with credit hours, single-semester or cumulative.
- [Middle School GPA Calculator](https://bestgpacalculator.online/middle-school-gpa-calculator): 6th-8th grade tracker.
- [Cumulative GPA Calculator](https://bestgpacalculator.online/cumulative-gpa-calculator): Combine multiple semesters.
- [Semester GPA Calculator](https://bestgpacalculator.online/semester-gpa-calculator): Single-term snapshot.
- [Current GPA Calculator](https://bestgpacalculator.online/current-gpa-calculator): Real-time mid-term.
- [AP GPA Calculator](https://bestgpacalculator.online/ap-gpa-calculator): AP class +1.0 boost only.
- [Honors GPA Calculator](https://bestgpacalculator.online/honors-gpa-calculator): +0.5 honors bonus.
- [Percentage to GPA Calculator](https://bestgpacalculator.online/percentage-to-gpa-calculator): Convert percentage grades to 4.0 scale.
- [GPA Calculator Without Credits](https://bestgpacalculator.online/gpa-calculator-without-credits): Equal-weight average.
- [AP Score to GPA Calculator](https://bestgpacalculator.online/ap-score-to-gpa-calculator): Predict college credits earned + GPA boost from AP exam scores 1-5.
- [GPA Goal Calculator](https://bestgpacalculator.online/gpa-goal-calculator): Reverse calculator — what GPA you need next semester to hit a target.

## Key Definitions

- **Weighted GPA**: A grade point average that gives extra credit for harder courses. Most US high schools add +0.5 to Honors and +1.0 to AP, IB, and dual-enrollment classes, so an A in an AP class is worth 5.0 instead of 4.0.
- **Unweighted GPA**: Standard 4.0 scale where every class counts equally regardless of difficulty. A=4.0, B=3.0, C=2.0, D=1.0, F=0.0.
- **Cumulative GPA**: Average across all completed terms, weighted by credit hours.
- **AP Exam Score**: Scored 1-5 by College Board. 3 = qualified, 4 = well qualified, 5 = extremely well qualified. Most colleges grant credit for 3+, selective colleges require 4+.
- **Honors Class**: A higher-rigor version of a regular course. Typically earns +0.5 weighting bonus.
- **Standard Weighting Scale**: +0.5 for Honors, +1.0 for AP/IB/dual-enrollment. Most common US scale.

## Authoritative Sources We Reference

- College Board (https://apstudents.collegeboard.org/) — official AP scoring and credit policies
- NCES (https://nces.ed.gov/) — National Center for Education Statistics
- IB Organization (https://www.ibo.org/) — International Baccalaureate
